{{Quote|General Jennir! Captain Greenbark! Thank the stars you've come to save us!|This Nosaurian|<ref name="DT 3" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Intro">The date of [[Dark Times 3|''Dark Times'' 3]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> a '''Nosaurian''' was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] within the slave pens on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]]. A [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]] escaping the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s [[Cleansing of New Plympto|cleansing]] of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], they were captured and sold into slavery on Orvax IV by the Empire. This [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a cramped cell with numerous others of the same [[Species/Legends|species]], including at one point the [[Parent/Legends|mother]]-daughter duo [[Mesa Greenbark|Mesa]] and [[Resa Greenbark]]. When enslavers on the planet came to take Resa<ref name="DT 3" /> for private sale in the upper levels of the planet,<ref name="DT 4">[[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]]</ref> the Nosaurian witnessed Mesa's death as she attempted to protect her daughter.<ref name="DT 3" />

Later that same [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Resa's father [[Bomo Greenbark]], a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in New Plympto's [[New Plympto resistance (Imperial Period)|resistance]], arrived, searching for his wife and daughter. The captured Nosaurian recognized Greenbark, as well as his companion [[General/Legends|General]] [[Dass Jennir]], believing that they had come to rescue the enslaved Nosaurians. As Bomo asked after his family, this individual recounted what had happened to them that morning.<ref name="DT 3" /> Jennir decided to search for Resa alone, and informed the captured Nosaurians that he was not going to free them as it would certainly bring about their [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. Jennir left, advising the prisoners to survive and forget that he and Greenbark had ever been there.<ref name="DT 4" />
